actual_scope: Minimize the paid elementary source-XOR count for the PR1340 common-B five-source universal connector at exactly ten B queries and two readouts per output, restoring all arbitrary dirty source rows.
scope_change_reason: PR1340 already implements the assigned alphabet extension but explicitly leaves its twelve source XORs unoptimized; refine to its complementary sharp shear-cost question.
bottleneck_link: A smaller complete source-mutation bill widens the conditional price range in which the changed common-map connector can save recursive map calls. This is an abstract interface result; no selected-supplier instance is established.
stop_rule: Within one 60-minute session, find and exactly replay a shorter source-shear word, then prove the below-four-shear boundary or record the unproved gap. Reserve final quarter for verification and submission.
evidence: Four source XORs attain the ten-query difference cover. Fewer than four reduce to the retained five-direction paired-path obstruction or cannot restore the sources. Literal free-polynomial and separate dense replay check complete dirty-state maps and fully charged recursive invoices.
author: Arham Tahir
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in algebra, implementation, verification and writing; no subagents or independent human review.

open_questions.why_it_matters: The proved shear minimum fixes ten B queries and two readouts per output; other complete tariffs may favor different counts.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate a bounded eleven-query/four-readout domain with source restoration, and compare complete tariffs to the known read-only repairs.
open_questions.blocked_by: There is no finite bound here on all admissible longer words or arbitrary weighted tariffs.

method: Source-restoration parity reduction, exhaustive short shear-word identities and independent pairing censuses; literal free noncommutative replay and separate dense F2 matrix checks.

optimistic_budget: 10b+62a+4x plus actual preparation/admission/dispatch. Compare to 10b+62a+2min(a,b) only after all complete prices are supplied.
